profiles.notes: 2026/27 direct entry using Tanzanian secondary qualifications or a formally assessed equivalent.

requirements.label: ACSEE · science subject combination
requirements.details: Earn principal passes in two of these subjects: chemistry, geography, physics and advanced mathematics.

source.title: Tanzania Commission for Universities · secondary school admission 2026/27 · PDF pp. 356, 357, 358, 359

requirements.label: ACSEE · sanitation engineering subjects
requirements.details: Choose two principal passes from advanced mathematics, biology, chemistry, geography and physics.

source.title: Tanzania Commission for Universities · secondary school admission 2026/27 · PDF pp. 357

requirements.label: Mathematics when neither principal pass is advanced mathematics
requirements.details: The guide requires a subsidiary pass in Basic Applied Mathematics at A level or Basic Mathematics at O level when advanced mathematics is absent from the qualifying principal passes. It does not give a numerical O-level grade.

source.title: Tanzania Commission for Universities · secondary school admission 2026/27 · PDF pp. 356, 357, 358, 359

requirements.label: ACSEE · community development
requirements.details: Two principal passes may come from any two subjects other than religious subjects.

source.title: Tanzania Commission for Universities · secondary school admission 2026/27 · PDF pp. 357

requirements.label: ACSEE · laboratory technology
requirements.details: Earn two principal passes from mathematics, physics, biology, geography and chemistry. At least one must be biology, chemistry or physics.

source.title: Tanzania Commission for Universities · secondary school admission 2026/27 · PDF pp. 359

requirements.label: ACSEE · 4.0 points and examination cohort
requirements.details: For the two qualifying subjects, reach 4.0 points in total. For school leavers before 2014 or from 2016 onwards, each principal pass must be E or above and grades A, B, C, D, E and S carry 5, 4, 3, 2, 1 and 0.5 points. For 2014–15 leavers, the minimum is C in each, with A, B+, B, C, D and E worth 5, 4, 3, 2, 1 and 0.5.

source.title: Tanzania Commission for Universities · secondary school admission 2026/27 · PDF pp. 13, 356–359

requirements.label: Recognition of overseas secondary qualifications
requirements.details: Water Institute assesses an international applicant’s overseas pre-university qualification against the Tanzanian ACSEE. Tanzanian applicants educated abroad obtain the applicable NECTA or NACTVET equivalence, index number and award verification number before applying through the domestic route.

source.title: Tanzania Commission for Universities · secondary school admission 2026/27 · PDF pp. 11

requirements.details: The secondary-school guide lists 100 places and 4 years of study for each linked degree.

profiles.notes: 2026/27 admission based on a diploma, technician certificate or equivalent qualification.

requirements.label: National school-leaving and award standards
requirements.details: The diploma route requires four O-level passes at D or above, NVA Level III with fewer than four passes, or a recognised foreign equivalent. The national minimum is GPA 3.0 on an NTA Level 6 ordinary diploma, or a C average on a Full Technician Certificate (FTC). The programme must accept the particular award and field.

source.title: Tanzania Commission for Universities · diploma and equivalent admission 2026/27 · PDF pp. 13

requirements.label: Recognition of foreign awards
requirements.details: The receiving institution obtains TCU recognition for an international applicant’s foreign university award. A Tanzanian applicant using a foreign university award submits its TCU recognition and follows the domestic equivalence process.

source.title: Tanzania Commission for Universities · diploma and equivalent admission 2026/27 · PDF pp. 11

requirements.label: Eligible diploma or FTC disciplines · water engineering
requirements.details: These programmes accept qualifications in civil engineering, hydrology and meteorology, hydrogeology and water-well drilling, water supply engineering, sanitation engineering, irrigation engineering, or operation and maintenance of water systems.

source.title: Tanzania Commission for Universities · diploma and equivalent admission 2026/27 · PDF pp. 556, 557, 558

requirements.label: Additional diploma or FTC disciplines · land planning
requirements.details: Land use planning and agricultural land use planning also qualify for this programme.

source.title: Tanzania Commission for Universities · diploma and equivalent admission 2026/27 · PDF pp. 556, 557, 558

requirements.label: Additional diploma or FTC disciplines · laboratory and related water fields
requirements.details: The programme also accepts water quality and laboratory technology or another water-related programme.

source.title: Tanzania Commission for Universities · diploma and equivalent admission 2026/27 · PDF pp. 556, 558

requirements.label: Eligible diploma or FTC disciplines · sanitation
requirements.details: Eligible fields are environmental health science, hydrology and meteorology, hydrogeology and water-well drilling, irrigation engineering, sanitation engineering, water supply engineering, water systems operation and maintenance, or water quality and laboratory technology.

source.title: Tanzania Commission for Universities · diploma and equivalent admission 2026/27 · PDF pp. 557

requirements.label: Community development · eligible diplomas and grades
requirements.details: Hold a diploma in anthropology, sociology, social work, public administration, tourism, community development, development studies or a water-related field, with at least a B average or GPA 3.0.

source.title: Tanzania Commission for Universities · diploma and equivalent admission 2026/27 · PDF pp. 557

requirements.label: Laboratory technology · eligible diploma or FTC
requirements.details: An ordinary diploma at NTA Level 6 or an FTC may be in environmental health science, general laboratory technology, water quality and laboratory technology, or water resources engineering.

source.title: Tanzania Commission for Universities · diploma and equivalent admission 2026/27 · PDF pp. 559

requirements.label: Quantity surveying · eligible diploma or FTC
requirements.details: Eligible fields include quantity surveying, metrology, mechanical or electrical engineering, civil or irrigation engineering, hydrology and meteorology, hydrogeology and water-well drilling, water supply and sanitation engineering, water quality laboratory technology and related fields.

source.title: Tanzania Commission for Universities · diploma and equivalent admission 2026/27 · PDF pp. 559

requirements.label: Registration · original documents and certified copies
requirements.details: Bring the relevant secondary, advanced secondary and certificate or diploma awards, plus the birth certificate. Supply both originals and certified copies. Bring three recent colour passport photographs.

requirements.label: Registration · signed forms and payment
requirements.details: Submit the completed acceptance and declaration, the signed medical report and proof of payment when registering.

requirements.label: 2026/27 September intake · reporting dates
requirements.details: Orientation and registration started on 26 October 2026, and classes began on 2 November. The institute states that arriving more than two weeks after the semester begins cancels the admission.
